title: Colourful Garden Party
desc: A bright outdoor party in full mixed colour.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The purple-yellow-pink-blue party mix climbing the arch.

items.role: Deep purple hydrangea massing at the arch top with the hanging purple tones.
Blue hydrangea accents on the right cluster (lighter backup: Angel Hydrangea - Blue).
Bright yellow roses warming the left-side cluster.
Pink roses mixed into the lower left planting (lighter backup: New Diamond Rose - Light Pink).
Pink larkspur spikes adding vertical accents near the base.

groups.label: Accents & fills
groups.blurb: Small faces scattering through the colour blocks.

items.role: Yellow daisies scattered around the yellow rose zone.
Purple daisies sprinkled under the purple hydrangea.
White lisianthus lightening the base clusters.
White statice filling the gaps between colour blocks.

groups.label: Hanging greenery & foliage
groups.blurb: The trailing greens cascading over the arch.

items.role: Long fine trailing green stems cascading from the arch top (closest trailing green — araucaria/pine droops are a logged gap).
Fountain grass plumes adding airy movement.
Round eucalyptus sprigs between the blooms.
Soft feathery tails trailing through the greenery.
